description.value: Waterfront Inn is one of three beachside motels under the Skaha Lake Motels group, situated steps from Skaha Lake in Penticton's Okanagan Valley. Rooms include air conditioning and kitchen or kitchenette options, and the motel is pet friendly. It sits directly across from Skaha Lake Park, which offers volleyball courts, a waterpark, and other public amenities. Note that check-in for all three properties is handled at the Beachside Motel at 3624 Parkview Street.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Waterfront Inn is one of three properties in the 'Skaha Lake Motels' collection at 3688 Parkview Street, Penticton. Free WiFi is explicitly listed in the amenities section. However, the phone number on the website (250.492.8318) differs from the OSM tag (+1-250-492-8228), and no bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-492-8228 but the website shows 250.492.8318 for the Waterfront Inn / Skaha Lake Motels group.

The OSM record is branded as 'Waterfront Inn' but the website operates under the umbrella brand 'Skaha Lake Motels'; the individual motel name is still confirmed, but correspondence should be directed to info@skahalakemotels.com or info@waterfrontinn.ca.
Check-in for all three motels is located at Beachside Motel (3624 Parkview St), not at Waterfront Inn itself — relevant for arriving cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate beachside motel in a popular cycling destination, but phone number on the website (250.492.8318) conflicts with OSM (+1-250-492-8228) and no bike storage or cycling amenities are mentioned — direct contact needed to confirm both the correct phone and any bike facilities before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Skaha Lake Motels group also operates Beachside Motel (3624 Parkview St) and Sunny Beach Motel (3648 Parkview St); all three may warrant separate OSM records and WWC review to avoid duplication.
